PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven software engineer with strong foundation in distributed systems, high-concurrency backend services, and clean architecture. Experienced in designing fault-tolerant microservices, optimizing database throughput, and shipping production code with rigorous test coverage.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering — Indian Institute of Technology Madras  2020 - 2024
Cumulative Grade Point Average: 8.40/10.0
WORK EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer - Core Services — PhonePe Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, India  Jun 2023 - Present
• Developed responsive internal operations dashboard in React and TypeScript with TanStack Query, accelerating merchant dispute resolution by 40%.
• Migrated monolithic checkout service to gRPC microservices, shrinking cloud compute costs by 32% and reducing deployment cycle times from 4 hours to 12 minutes.
• Engineered distributed idempotency layer with Redis and PostgreSQL, eliminating 100% of double-debit anomalies during peak flash sales.

Peer-to-Peer File Transfer Protocol with NAT Traversal | Technologies: Rust, STUN/TURN, UDP, Tokio, Cryptography

• Achieved wire-speed throughput of 940 Mbps over local gigabit connections using zero-copy memory-mapped file buffers.
Autonomous Code Review Linter & Security Auditor | Technologies: Python, AST, Tree-sitter, Docker, FastAPI

• Containerized execution sandbox using gVisor and Docker to securely isolate untrusted student code submissions.
